notes: «كلاهما عن ابن مسهر» then «قال إسماعيل أخبرنا علي بن مسهر»: the same man written twice in succession, read as one link (rule 7)
«وأخبرني عبد الله بن عروة» is a second isnad for the same narrative; its top is read as Ismail only, since the text does not write the link above Ibn Urwa
The closing quotation («فقال أما والله لقد جمع لي») is spoken by the father, named only as «لأبي»; whether he is the last link is unsettled (rule 6)
